budget_items.topic: FY24 formula funding award from DHCD
budget_items.what_was_recorded: DHCD letter announced the FY24 formula funding amount, based on the number of units.
budget_items.quote: letter from dhcd announcing our fy24 formula funding of $63,069.00.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Income was reported above budget, and the bottom line was a surplus; COVID money must be spent by December 31.
budget_items.quote: income is up a little from what was budgeted by $25,793.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The subsidy is down 4 percent for the year.
budget_items.quote: this year there is a 4% decrease in our subsidy of $8,321.

budget_items.topic: FY2021 budget administrative and fee lines
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Admin Other was reduced, the management fee rose 3 percent, and accounting fees rose 3 percent; maintenance contract costs rose.
budget_items.quote: 4190 admin other were able to bring that down from previous year by $4700.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Property insurance per-unit cost rose considerably.
budget_items.quote: property insurance went up considerably from $126/unit to $170/unit.

budget_items.topic: Projected subsidy and operating income, FY2021
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Projected subsidy earnings and operating income; reserves after the truck purchase.
budget_items.quote: projected to have an income of $1,705 for operations; with the $20,000 truck purchase reserves will be at $18,295

budget_items.topic: Used truck with plow from Leominster H.A.
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Non-routine used truck with plow being sold by Leominster H.A. to Lunenburg H.A.; not yet purchased, and staff plan to do snow plowing in-house.
budget_items.quote: used truck with plow for $20,000 being sold by leominster h.a. to lune nburg h.a.

budget_items.topic: Snow and ice removal contract bid
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Two responses received; lowest bid from Lakeview Nurseries recommended.
budget_items.quote: we received two responses with the lowest bid of $20,117.42 from lakeview nurseries out of lunenburg.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: DHCD awarded emergency funding, outside capital funding, to replace the elderly-side septic system.
budget_items.quote: dhcd awarding us $250,000 in emergency funding, outside of our capital funding, to replace the septic system on the elderly side.
